\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}

↗ prob:1-7 1-11. Let $M = {\overline{\mathbb {B}}}^{n}$ , the closed unit ball in ${\mathbb {R}}^{n}$ . Show that $M$ is a topological manifold with boundary in which each point in ${\mathbb {S}}^{n - 1}$ is a boundary point and each point in ${\mathbb {B}}^{n}$ is an interior point. Show how to give it a smooth structure such that every smooth interior chart is a smooth chart for the standard smooth structure on ${\mathbb {B}}^{n}$ . [Hint: consider the map $\pi \circ {\sigma }^{-1} : {\mathbb {R}}^{n} \rightarrow {\mathbb {R}}^{n}$ , where $\sigma : {\mathbb {S}}^{n} \rightarrow {\mathbb {R}}^{n}$ is the stereographic projection (Problem 1-7) and $\pi $ is a projection from ${\mathbb {R}}^{n + 1}$ to ${\mathbb {R}}^{n}$ that omits some coordinate other than the last.] \end{exercise}
